purpose: Metadata-only public HST/WFC3-IR exposure identification for DES16E1dcx; no science-image acquisition, photometry or fits
query: MAST.Caom.Cone ra/dec/radius=30/3600 degrees; retain HST WFC3/IR F125W/F160W image observations. First-pass first-visit window MJD [57714.627,57716.630]; then metadata-only all same-target visits for proposal 14216 and any competing HST programs, comparing each source epoch within +/-1 observer day and noting later reference epochs separately.
products: MAST.Caom.Products metadata for matched target observation IDs only; preserve all product-level filenames, types, calibration levels, release/access rights, sizes, dataURI/URL, checksums if supplied; no dataURI fetch
interpretation: Compare spatial/time/filter/program matches and ambiguity. Archived FLT may enable future pixel validation, but neither calibrated FLT nor drizzled archive products are assumed identical to private *_e01 or *_sub_masked image intermediates. Representative SIMLIB LIBID11 RA/Dec is not the primary-paper SN sky coordinate.
